baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence صورة / شاء / ركب and the open alternative introduced by أي.
baseline_models.mechanism: A possible configuration is selected by will and then realized by fixing constituent parts into their places; the verse presents embodiment as particularized composition rather than an unanalysed appearance.

activation_trace.role: The formed-shape branch supplies the field of possible configurations in which the addressee can appear.
The willing-toward-a-thing branch makes one configuration a purposive selection rather than an accident.
The fitting branch contributes the concrete operation of fixing parts into a composed whole.

changed_reading.after: He selected one possible embodied configuration and made it actual by fitting its constituents together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: صورة as formed configuration joined to the superpositional branch of ركب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Composition can occur by placing one thing over another, so the selected form is not merely an outer silhouette but a depth-structured, layered body whose visible unity rests on hidden superposition.

activation_trace.role: The sensible-or-intelligible form branch supplies the whole that presents as one configuration.
The willing branch assigns the layered configuration to deliberate choice.
The overlap-and-superposition branch turns composition into stacked depth rather than surface outline.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns the body's visible outline.
changed_reading.after: The visible form is the outward unity of a deliberately layered and superposed embodiment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The directional branch of صورة, the impelling branch of شاء, and the riding branch of ركب converge on motion.
baseline_models.mechanism: Form can carry an orientation, willing can drive something toward a matter, and composition can evoke mounting; together they allow the body to be read as a conveyance that places the addressee on a chosen bearing, not only as an object with a chosen look.

activation_trace.role: The inclining-toward-a-direction branch supplies a bearing latent within form.
The driving-toward-a-matter branch supplies directed impetus rather than neutral preference.
The mounting-and-riding branch makes embodiment function as a conveyance along that bearing.

changed_reading.before: Your body is a statically shaped object.
changed_reading.after: Your selected embodiment also mounts you into a direction and furnishes the vehicle of your course.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant marking image carried by السماء converges with the distinguishing sign of علم and inscription into a register under كتب. This makes the selected صورة readable: embodiment is not only shape but an identifying signature that can be recognized and entered into an evidentiary order.

activation_trace.role: The formed image supplies a visible and intelligible configuration capable of bearing identity.
The split-root branch of a visible mark that makes a thing known activates form as an identifying trace.
The distinguishing sign that guides recognition turns bodily particularity into readable evidence.
The branch of entering a name in a register extends recognized identity into recorded identity.

structural_cues: The context moves from a visibly altered sky to a self that knows and then to watchers who write.
The non-dominant و س م mapping supplies a mark-image without replacing the surface root س م و.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formed image, visible mark, distinguishing sign, and registry; I infer that bodily particularity functions as an identifying inscription. A live alternative is that these are separate images of sky, knowledge, and bookkeeping with no claim that form itself is evidence.

changed_reading.before: The selected form is a private physical appearance.
changed_reading.after: The selected form is also a public, knowable signature by which this particular self can be recognized and accounted for.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening, scattering, bursting, and bottom-to-top overturning of prior wholes reverse the focus verb's fitting and superposition. The body in 82:8 becomes the local counterimage to a cosmos being taken apart: تركيب names constructed integrity whose operations become legible when other constructed orders are undone.

activation_trace.role: The fitting branch supplies the positive operation reversed by the surrounding acts of disassembly.
The superposition branch makes the composed body's hidden layers available to reversal and exposure.
Opening and splitting provide the first inverse of a fitted whole.
Casting constituents apart reverses the gathering implicit in composition.
Wide splitting with outflow shows containment failing from within.
Turning the lower part uppermost supplies complete inversion of an ordered structure.

structural_cues: Four repeated إذا clauses present a sequence of passive transformations before the focus address.
The sequence moves from enclosure through dispersion and outflow to exposure of what had been buried.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fitting and superposition on one side and four modes of opening or inversion on the other; I supply the reversible-operation arrow from composition to de-composition. A live alternative is that the cosmic transformations only set the time of judgment and do not analyze the body's construction.

changed_reading.before: God assembled you into a stable finished shape.
changed_reading.after: God made you a constructed integrity whose fitted and layered character is exposed by the context's systematic unmaking of other wholes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self's inner awareness, خلق as inward disposition, performed acts, and their accounting widen صورة beyond anatomy. The fitted configuration can include embodied capacities and temperament, while the later attribution of فعل to the addressees prevents those given capacities from being equated with predetermined deeds.

activation_trace.role: The branch explicitly spanning sensible and intelligible form permits configuration to exceed visible anatomy.
Fitting supplies an architecture in which bodily and inward capacities can function together.
Mind and inward awareness locate knowing within the same self that was composed.
The inward-disposition branch makes created form potentially psychosomatic rather than merely exterior.
Accounting and recompense keep moral evaluation distinct from the capacities supplied in creation.
Bringing about an action assigns deeds to the addressees rather than to their given configuration alone.

structural_cues: The نفس of 82:5 knows its temporally extended deeds before the direct account of its creation in 82:7-8.
The later plural address distinguishes what was done to you in creation from what you yourselves do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward awareness, disposition, fitted form, human action, and accounting; I infer that created configuration includes enabling capacities but does not author accountable acts. A live alternative restricts صورة to physical shape and treats inward خلق as irrelevant to this token.

changed_reading.before: The verse specifies only external bodily shape.
changed_reading.after: The verse can encompass an integrated bodily and inward endowment that conditions action without cancelling responsibility for action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dominant رب branch of nurturing toward completion and its non-dominant ربو branch of feeding and growth turn composition from a single fabrication event into developmental realization. Parts are not only fixed; they are brought toward fitness through sustained growth under lordly care.

activation_trace.role: Purposive willing supplies the selected developmental outcome.
Fitting supplies the progressive integration of developing constituents.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing recast the maker's relation as sustained formation.
The split-root image of nourishment and growth supplies the temporal process by which composition matures.

structural_cues: ربك immediately precedes the relative sequence خلقك فسواك فعدلك and its completion in ركبك.
The repeated second-person suffix carries one addressee through successive formative operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurturing-to-completion, nourishment and growth, willing, and fitting; I infer a temporal arrow from care through maturation to integrated form. A live alternative reads all creation verbs as a completed originary sequence with no emphasis on development.

changed_reading.before: Your form was assembled in one completed act.
changed_reading.after: Your willed configuration was brought into coherence through a nurtured process of growth and integration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate titles of nurturing lordship and generosity give ethical valence to شاء: particularization need not be arbitrary selection but can be an act of care and honor. This reading remains in tension with the following warning that generosity itself can be misread.

activation_trace.role: Willing toward a thing supplies deliberate particularization of the addressee.
The formed-shape branch locates honor in the gift of a particular embodied configuration.
Nurturing and completion frame selection as care directed toward fitness.
Honor and praised generosity supply a beneficent rather than capricious valence to the willed form.

structural_cues: ربك الكريم governs the relative creation sequence that continues through 82:7-8.
The interrogative rebuke in 82:6 prevents generosity from becoming mere reassurance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies willing, nurturing completion, and generosity; I infer that the selected form is a mode of honored care. A live alternative is that الكريم intensifies accountability for ingratitude without characterizing the particular form as beneficent.

changed_reading.before: Whatever form He happened to prefer, He imposed on you.
changed_reading.after: He deliberately particularized you within a formative relation marked by nurture and generosity, though that generosity can itself become the occasion of self-deception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deceptive glint of غرر and the garment whose appearance lies under كذب create an epistemic countermodel to form as readable evidence. A visible configuration can disclose deliberate composition, yet the same surface can be treated as self-sufficient display and thereby conceal dependence on its composer.

activation_trace.role: Visible formed appearance supplies the surface that can either be read through or stopped at.
Hidden fitting supplies the compositional dependence that surface-only perception misses.
A glittering promise that does not hold activates the risk of mistaking display for stable reality.
The garment that lies by its condition supplies the precise analogy of an exterior misrepresenting what underlies it.

structural_cues: The focus account of form stands between the question ما غرك and the reversal كلا بل تكذبون.
The text moves from a singular addressee admiring or trusting wrongly to plural denial of accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible form, concealed fitting, deceptive glint, and a lying garment; I infer that embodiment can be misread as autonomous surface. A live alternative is that deception concerns delayed judgment or generosity alone and never makes the body an epistemic test.

changed_reading.before: The body's form transparently displays a completed creative act.
changed_reading.after: The body's form is ambiguous evidence: it can disclose its fitting, or its polished surface can be misread as independence from the one who fitted it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measurement, equalization, and the balancing of one load against another specify how fitting works. The selected form is a calibrated, load-bearing arrangement: constituents are proportioned and counterweighted so the whole can stand and operate, not merely look distinctive.

activation_trace.role: Form supplies the resultant configuration whose organization needs explanation.
Fitting parts into place supplies the assembly operation refined by the preceding verbs.
Estimating and measuring supply prior specification of constituent proportions.
Equalization between two things supplies relational calibration within the whole.
A load balanced by a counterload makes bodily equilibrium functional and load-bearing.

structural_cues: Three successive verbs in 82:7 repeat the second-person object before 82:8 names the resulting configuration.
The sequence reads naturally as specification, equalization, balancing, and fitting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measuring, equalizing, balancing loads, and fitting parts; I infer an operational sequence producing dynamic bodily stability. A live alternative takes عدل as moral rectitude or simple uprightness and does not derive an engineering mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The chosen form is chiefly aesthetic or taxonomic.
changed_reading.after: The chosen form is a measured system of fitted and counterbalanced parts designed to bear loads and remain operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The joining branch of كتب mirrors the fitting branch of ركب but changes the agent and material. God composes the embodied person; vigilant writers then join that person's acts into a record. The context therefore places a received composition beside an authored behavioral composition without collapsing either into the other.

activation_trace.role: Fitting parts supplies the first composition, the addressee's received embodiment.
Watching and guarding ensure that the second composition retains its evidentiary material.
Joining one thing to another makes writing a compositional counterpart to bodily fitting.
Acts brought about by the addressees supply the pieces joined into their accountable record.

structural_cues: The passive relation عليكم locates observers over the addressees before writers and deeds are named.
The second-person object of divine formation becomes the second-person subject of فعل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily fitting, guarded observation, writing-as-joining, and human acts; I infer a formal analogy between a received body and an accumulating record. A live alternative treats كتب only as ordinary writing and sees no compositional parallel with ركب.

changed_reading.before: 82:8 closes the account of how the person was made.
changed_reading.after: 82:8 begins a contrast between the body composed for the person and the record progressively composed from what that embodied person does.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that expresses willing in the focus returns as the slightest thing that no self can possess or deploy for another. Possession and governing authority then disappear from creatures at the endpoint. This brackets embodiment as a received allotment: its form is willed for the self but never becomes the self's absolute property or command.

activation_trace.role: Divine willing toward a thing supplies the originating agency behind the particular form.
Fitting makes the body something received through another's compositional act.
Possession with power of disposal supplies exactly the capacity denied to every self at the endpoint.
The knowable thing, reduced by negation to not even one thing, answers the focus root's act of willing.
Governing authority supplies the control that the final clause reserves beyond creaturely possession.

structural_cues: شاء in the focus and شيئا in the final ayah repeat one root in different grammatical roles.
The singular you who receives a form is answered by the final نفس لنفس relation in which no self can act possessively for another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine willing, received fitting, denied possession, and reserved authority; I infer that the final dispossession exposes a non-ownership already latent in created form. A live alternative confines the loss of possession to the judgment event and allows ordinary embodied ownership before it.

changed_reading.before: God chose the body that thereafter belongs to the self.
changed_reading.after: The self inhabits a particular configuration willed and fitted for it, but the final denial of all disposal reveals that this embodiment was never absolutely self-owned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because all three focus roots are activated through rare palm or growth branches rather than their obvious token senses. It remains worth carrying because clustered palms, young palms, and a rootless high offshoot form an unusually coherent packet-internal ecological mechanism, strengthened by the split-root image of nourishment and growth. Downstream prose should label it a cross-branch cultivation analogy, never a translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The three focus words each possess a packet branch participating in one palm-growth system.

activation_trace.role: Clustered palms supply the living stand or patterned field in which an individual growth takes form.
Young palms supply developing material selected from within that living field.
The high palm offshoot fixed on a trunk supplies graft-like emergence and attachment.
The non-dominant nourishment-and-growth branch gives the ecological assembly a developmental cause.

changed_reading.before: The body is manufactured from inert components.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological analogy, the body is cultivated into form like a selected offshoot emerging from and fitted onto living stock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The blown-horn branch is form-distant from the singular صورة in this syntax, so it cannot displace the formed-shape reading. It remains a valid root-level echo because graves are uncovered and the severe day repeatedly approaches, while ركب supplies re-composition. Downstream prose must call this an acoustic-resurrection undertone activated by the root inventory, not claim that صورة here means horn.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun carries the horn branch under ص و ر while the focus verb carries fitted composition.

activation_trace.role: The blown horn supplies a remote acoustic trigger shadowing the ordinary formed-shape reading.
Fitting and composition supply the possible reassembly following that remote trigger.
Burial of the dead supplies the concealed human material implicated by the horn echo.
Turning earth and exposing what was buried supplies the transition from concealment toward reassembly.
The severe event of the day supplies the eschatological horizon in which the echo becomes live.

changed_reading.before: The verse refers only to the first composition of a bodily form.
changed_reading.after: At root-echo level only, the first composition is faintly shadowed by a horn-associated exposure and re-composition at the severe day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because origin or social stock is a peripheral noun-branch of ركب and not the direct causative sense of ركبك. It remains anchored because that branch explicitly makes a person's origin a مركب, while the split رب inventory contributes household kin and كرم contributes honor. Downstream prose should present chosen lineage-placement as a social analogy within embodiment, without turning inherited rank into moral worth or a primary lexical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ركب links composition to a person's origin or stock, while صورة and شاء retain selected particularity.

activation_trace.role: Origin and stock supply a social placement that can accompany physical composition.
Particular form supplies the embodied individual situated within that origin.
Willing supplies selection of situated particularity rather than self-chosen origin.
The split-root household-and-cousins branch activates kin structure around the composed person.
Honor and generosity prevent social placement from being reduced to biological mechanism alone.

changed_reading.before: Only anatomy is assigned in the chosen form.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary social echo, the composed self is also placed into an unchosen origin, kin structure, and inherited human situation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the pubic-region branch belongs to a nominal edge of ر ك ب while the focus token is the causative composition verb. It remains bodily anchored through صورة, the reproductive branch of نفس, and the preceding claim of complete, balanced creation. Downstream prose should qualify it as a corporeal undertone that lets 'any form' include sexed and reproductive embodiment, not sexualize the address or redefine ركبك.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The selected bodily form and the pubic-region branch of the focus verb's root.

activation_trace.role: The formed body supplies the whole within which sexed anatomy is one particularized constituent.
Willing supplies the particularization implied by variation among embodied forms.
The pubic or genital region supplies the specific hidden anatomy activated within composition.
Childbirth and postpartum blood connect embodied differentiation to reproductive process.
Complete and balanced bodily creation contains the activated anatomy within the integrity of the whole.

changed_reading.before: Form varies only in general visible appearance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained corporeal undertone, chosen composition includes hidden sexed and reproductive anatomy as part of embodied particularity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus speaks of fitting whereas the later fire token most directly evokes encountering heat; the straightening-by-fire branch is a secondary root image. It remains anchored through the explicit composition branch of ركب and the context's blazing heat. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy in which heat acts on a composed body, not assert that punishment literally improves or recreates it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fitted composition of ركبك is a material whole upon which the later heat image can act.

activation_trace.role: Form supplies the configuration exposed to a later material transformation.
Fitting supplies the composed material whose integrity heat can test or alter.
Blazing and intense heat supply the transforming medium.
Kindling and straightening a thing by fire supply the form-distant operation of forced material reconfiguration.

changed_reading.before: The composed form is a finished and inert product.
changed_reading.after: As a material outlier, the composed form remains susceptible to an exposing and forcibly reconfiguring encounter with heat.

strongest_changes: The opening, scattering, bursting, and inversion of prior wholes recast ركبك as constructed integrity understood through its contextual reverse, de-composition.
Measurement, equalization, and balanced loads turn the selected form from appearance into a calibrated operating arrangement.
Visible marking, distinguishing knowledge, and registration activate bodily form as an identifying and evidentiary signature.
Writing-as-joining mirrors bodily fitting, separating the body composed for a person from the record composed out of that person's acts.
The return of ش ي ء under denied possession at 82:19 reframes chosen embodiment as received configuration rather than absolute self-property.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several incompatible but functional readings at once: form as fitted body, layered depth, directional conveyance, readable signature, possible deceptive surface, developmental growth, social placement, and revocable possession. Non-dominant mappings supplied two especially productive activations, س م و toward visible marking and ر ب ب toward nourishment and growth, while the rare palm branches of all three focus roots produced a coherent ecological outlier that a conservative reading would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The directional, palm-growth, horn, lineage, genital, and thermal branches are real packet anchors but remain distant from the most likely token senses.
Reading created form as including inward disposition must preserve the context's separate attribution of actions to human agents.
The final denial of possession may expose a standing non-ownership of embodiment, or it may describe only the exceptional conditions of the judgment event.
The visible-mark model and deceptive-surface model remain intentionally coexistent: the same form may be evidence rightly read or appearance wrongly absolutized.
